provenance.notes: Google Maps Platform Terms (last modified 2026-08-26) and Service Specific Terms (2026-10-28). Limits: quotas are per Cloud project, set and shown in the Cloud console (Google Maps Platform > Quotas); the usage and billing pages of the Geocoding and Maps Static APIs publish no default figure, so none is declared (unsigned Static Maps requests have a lower quota than signed ones). Caching: "Customer will not cache Google Maps Content except as expressly permitted under the Maps Service Specific Terms": the Geocoding API's latitude and longitude for up to 30 consecutive calendar days (6.3.1; the geocoder_ttl default), place IDs indefinitely; no pre-fetching, indexing, storing, resharing or rehosting outside the Services, no bulk download of tiles or geocodes. A picture of a Google map kept in omnimap's map cache is Google Maps Content: keep the map cache to other providers. Display: the Google Maps Core Services are not used with or near a non-Google map, and Geocoding API content not in conjunction with a non-Google map (6.2): a Google geocode is not drawn on an OpenStreetMap or MapLibre map. Attribution: the Google Maps logo whenever possible, the text "Google Maps" where space is limited (unmodified, not localized), the data providers' notices Google gives, never removed, hidden or obscured; the Maps JavaScript API and Static Maps draw them on the map. Commercial use: under the Google Maps Platform agreement accepted with the billing account and key.
